findings.basis: Reads native_replay/execution receipts and binds watchdog worker SHA and same endpoint records.
Requires successful exact-update500 builder receipt, folder and ZIP inventory hashes, and linked relocation/reference inference receipts for the same endpoint.
Checks six unique updates and Adam steps per arm, all actual 776-record unique-ID journals, update/protocol/validation SHA and same-weight gate conjunction; all six science flags must be false.
Preflights every generated report and ZIP, constructs report payloads in memory, and publishes reports only after ZIP bytes have been verified.
Both writing and reopening compare every ZIP entry with the fixed inventory size and SHA; the release manifest itself is bound by the external seal receipt.
Report explicitly restricts byte-preserving archive claim to the new release manifest and excludes the 1046 baseline files and full training raw/cache.

additional_closed_items: Single old-DEV negative_normal/noise relocation scope stated explicitly.
Only the CPU mock success receipt is copied into the release inventory; fixture data remain excluded.
Actual 500x4 journal case IDs must equal frozen sampling before exposure is reported.
limitations: This is static and existing-schema review, not execution of the seal entrypoint.
The final v4.6 results, raw replay, bundle and relocation receipts are to be checked after root executes them.
Existing outputs and failed partial archives are refused, retained and never overwritten automatically.
